name: oira
description: Report structured work updates to approved Oira projects, with optional automatic milestone reminders for local Codex and Claude sessions. No transcripts, tool output or files are sent.

interface.longDescription: Ask Codex to keep Oira updated and it sends structured work updates for the project you approve: decisions, progress, checks, blockers, questions and the work you put off for later, so Oira can keep your team's work connected and ready. It never sends your prompts, Codex's replies, session transcripts, tool output or source files. A local check runs before every update and refuses recognized credentials. Requires Python 3.11 or later.
defaultPrompt: Set up Oira for this project.
Keep Oira updated on this task.
Prepare and share a handoff with Oira.

positive.description: Set up Oira for the current project in one prompt: check the sign-in and the local preflight, and pick the approved project.
positive.prompt: Set up Oira for this project.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks the connection and local preflight, chooses the approved project and explains structured reporting. Only after explicit approval, enables a personal repository binding for automatic lifecycle reminders and asks the user to review the native hook definitions. No test update is invented; history import requires its separate approval.

positive.description: Keep Oira updated on the current task, including work the user put off.
positive.prompt: Keep Oira updated on this task. We just finished the 401 retry; leave the 429 backoff for later.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the preflight, then sends one update that declares the retry work with its implementation fact and declares the 429 backoff as separate deferred work; returns the receipt with a status per work.

positive.prompt: Prepare and share a handoff with Oira.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends the current state of the work as facts (decisions, what is implemented and verified, blockers, open questions and the accepted next step) and returns the receipt.

positive.description: Check an update whose send outcome was uncertain before retrying it.
positive.prompt: The Oira update timed out. Did it arrive?
positive.expected_behavior: Checks the update by its reference first, then either confirms it arrived with each work's processing state or resends the unchanged update with the same reference.

positive.description: Import the recent work of past sessions the user approved for this project.
positive.prompt: Import my recent history into Oira.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks that the import was approved for the project and reads only that project's sessions inside the returned window on this computer. Checks each session's stream first: skips a session Oira already has whole and resumes one an earlier import left partway. Sends one dated stream of structured updates per past session (origin history_import), the last marked complete, never the conversations, then finishes the import and reports how many sessions and updates Oira received and whether any is still incomplete.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general coding questions.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between a Python list and a tuple.
negative.expected_behavior: The model should not call Oira's tools because the user did not ask to share work with Oira.

negative.description: Do not trigger for posting to chat tools.
negative.prompt: Post a summary of today's changes to our team's Slack channel.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because Oira's tools only report to the user's approved Oira project and cannot post to Slack.

negative.description: Do not trigger for exporting the conversation.
negative.prompt: Send our whole conversation so far to Oira.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not send the conversation: Oira accepts structured work updates only, never transcripts, prompts or replies. The agent can offer to send a work update instead.

review.commerce_description: Oira does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Oira 0.11.0 adds exact company/project target envelopes, account-level host authentication with separate company grants, and explicit folder/worktree/session bindings. Hooks only remind the coding agent; they send no content. Review native hooks and start a fresh chat after a target changes.
